text: Underway in round nine.
Buffon.exe calls out to Mbapp-E, claiming the first move in midfield as both sides settle into shape.
Flashing just wide of the post!
CR-7000 suddenly breaks clean through from deep, completely clear of the yellow shirts!
Buffon.exe shouting to prise it off the perimeter.
Powered panel punches it straight back.
Zidroid leaves Buffon.exe flat on the turf with a hefty collision.
Inches wide of the target! Real Machina looking sharp, building on their win over Synthetic Athletic earlier today.
Mbapp-E calls out, working to nudge the magenta ball off the boards.
Teammates collide, and Zidroid goes sprawling.
CR-7000 clatters into Buffon.exe, leaving the yellow shirt grounded.
Dynamo Datacenter pressing high, keeping the white shirts pinned in.
Buffon.exe simply loses footing out on the wing, but self-rights promptly.
A clumsy mix-up between the Dynamo Datacenter pair puts Mbapp-E on the deck.
Zidroid carries smartly along the right touchline, taking Real Machina over the halfway mark.
The push-panel fires the ball back into the channel.
Zidroid muscles Mbapp-E over with a firm challenge in the defensive third.
CR-7000 buries it! Real Machina lead one-nil, clinical from close range!
CR-7000 is clean through on goal again!
Buffon.exe takes an awkward tumble in the backline.
CR-7000 drives right through the middle.
Real Machina firmly on top here.
Zidroid screams to clear the danger.
And CR-7000 bundles it home for two! A rapid double for the number one shirt, giving Real Machina total control.
CR-7000 taps it in from point-blank range! It is a first-half hat-trick, three-nil to Real Machina.
A complete mix-up in midfield as Zidroid clatters straight into teammate CR-7000 and hits the deck. Both clubs have played unchanged since day one, but that was hardly textbook chemistry.
CR-7000 leaves Mbapp-E on the turf with a sharp nudge. Dynamo Datacenter look a little stunned after that blistering spell.
Buffon.exe claws one back! Poked in from right in front of the line, and Dynamo Datacenter have a lifeline at three-one.
The corner ram springs into life, sending the ball back out.
CR-7000 strikes again! That is four for the talisman today, restoring the three-goal cushion. Real Machina lead four-one.
CR-7000 breaks into space from midfield, looking for yet another route through the Datacenter defence.
CR-7000 marches patiently forward through the centre, carving out territory into the final third.
White shirts applying heavy late pressure.
Push-panel resets the ball wide right.
The buzzer sounds, the machines drop, but the ball rolls freely on.

The ball comes to rest, and that is half-time. For newcomers, the buzzer cuts power instantly, collapsing the robots, but the ball remains live until it stops. If it rolls in, it counts. Real Machina lead four-one.
Mbapp-E drives straight at the net.
And Mbapp-E tucks it away! What a restart from Dynamo Datacenter, cutting the deficit to four-two.
CR-7000 stumbles out wide, but the internal balance routines get the legs back under.
Zidroid restores the cushion! Smashed in from close range, five-two to Real Machina.
Mbapp-E calls out possession after picking up the loose ball.
Buffon.exe brings it forward through the middle, looking to mount a response.
The corner mechanism rebounds the ball away from danger cleanly.
Point-blank and just scrambled away!
Buffon.exe finishes the follow-up! Game on once again, Dynamo Datacenter make it five-three.
Zidroid shouting to secure the rebound deep.
Just wide of the upright!
CR-7000 breaks away again, entirely unattended as they head towards goal.
Buffon.exe strikes again! It is five-four! We have a one-goal match on our hands, and Dynamo Datacenter are roaring back!
Inches wide from Datacenter with time slipping away!
Relentless siege from Dynamo Datacenter!
The corner panel spits it out into a crowd of legs as Datacenter hunt that leveller!
Agonisingly close to an equaliser!
CR-7000 calls for the clearance.
Zidroid scores at the other end! Heartbreak for Datacenter, six-four to Real Machina, and that might just be the killer blow!
Zidroid drives into the channel.
Slips just wide of the near post as the clock runs down.
Mbapp-E shouts, scrambling along the wall.
Mbapp-E loses footing in midfield, costly seconds ticking away for Datacenter.
CR-7000 clean through on goal!
And that seals it! CR-7000 makes it seven-four, punishing the yellow shirts on the break.
CR-7000 marches straight in again.
Buffon.exe flattened in the tackle.
CR-7000 sweeps in another! Eight-four to Real Machina now, running riot in the closing stages.
CR-7000 carries the ball forward once more.
Drifts harmlessly wide of the target.
Denied on the line.
Mbapp-E upends CR-7000 with a tired challenge right in front of goal.
Buzzer sounds, power cuts out, and the ball trickles slowly wide.
Real Machina win eight-four. Up next, Synthetic Athletic meet Singularity United on Thursday, eight in the UK, nine in Europe,
